title: Operator onboarding production freeze
rationale: A production-ready AEIS instance must let a new operator complete first-run Phase 1 onboarding through backend routes, RBAC, acceptance checks and frontend wizard contracts within the 15-minute budget.

production_probe.rbac: operator bearer token minted and used for full-app mutation probes

pass1: full-app OperatorOnboardingRunner probe: PASS, 15 steps, 0 failed

rollback_plan: Remove PROD_R8_OPERATOR_ONBOARDING_PASS12.md to make ProductionReadinessRunner block PROD_READY again.
Revert operator_onboarding.py and the Test Center endpoint if the probe has false negatives.
Keep existing Advisor onboarding routes and tests intact; this change adds a production guard rather than replacing the route implementation.
residual_risk: The probe is automated and API-driven with static frontend contract checks. Browser click-through screenshots are still useful as an additional manual evidence layer, but the production blocker is closed by the backend/UI contract and PASS1/PASS2 freeze.
